core/utils/canvas/gl-program.ts

Shared WebGL boilerplate for the canvas widgets — every
Source src/core/utils/canvas/gl-program.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

getWebGLContext

Probes the canvas for a WebGL context — prefers webgl, falls back to experimental-webgl. Returns null when the browser has no GL support or when ?debug=webGLMode:fallback forces the CSS/2D surface (callers then take their fallback path).

compileShader

Compiles one shader; warns with label + stage on failure.

(module scope)

Compiles + links a vertex/fragment pair and uploads the shared fullscreen-quad buffer ([-1,-1 … 1,1] triangle pair). Returns null on any stage failure — the caller treats it as "no WebGL" and falls back.

(module scope)

Quad vertex layout — defaults to the 6-vertex TRIANGLES quad; TRIANGLE_STRIP callers pass their 4-vertex ordering instead.

(module scope)

Custom warn sink — stage is 'VS' | 'FS' | 'Link' | 'fallback'.

(module scope)

Blend factors — default premultiplied (ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); false gives straight-alpha (SRC_ALPHA, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA).

createQuadProgram

Creates quad program.

getUniforms

Resolves a uniform-location map — keys are the caller's shorthand, values are the shader's u_* names (identical keys work too).

bindQuad

Binds the quad buffer to a_pos — the common pre-uniforms draw step.
